title: On Knots
container-title: Transactions of the Royal Society of Edinburgh
note: Part I of Tait's knot tables, begun to give Kelvin's vortex atoms a periodic table; source of the Tait conjectures (crossing number, writhe, flyping), settled a century later via the Jones polynomial. Parts II (1884) and III (1885) appeared in vol. 32. Bibliographic data verified 2026-11-22 against Cambridge Core and Zenodo; free PDF at https://zenodo.org/records/1844250/files/article.pdf.
